voyage.text: The guiding star is shining in the sky again.
Now the boats won't get lost!
Today let's sail to the island across the sea. It's Hutton Island.
It was bright, then dark… Now it's bright again!

prologue.text: Don't be scared. We're from Puppy Land. Who are you?
I'm… the keeper of this island.
The island is acting strange. The sun comes up and goes right back down. The rain suddenly turns to snow.
Look over there. The big sundial in the middle of the island is broken.
A sundial tells the time with the sun's shadow. When it broke, the island's time got all mixed up.
The pieces flew to the hills, the beach and the valley.
So that's why the island is so strange… You must have been really worried.
But why did the sundial break?
I don't know. One night I heard a big BOOM, and it was broken.
Don't worry. We'll find all the pieces. And we'll find out why it broke!
…Really? Thank you. I'll show you the way.
